{{Top|leg}}
'''Slickplast posters''' were a form of advertising that could be stuck on walls. On [[Terman Station]], [[Slickplast/Legends|slickplast]] posters were used to advertise a band's [[Music/Legends|musical]] tour. The posters covered bas-relief [[Kucha-sculpt|''kucha''-sculpts]].<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
